text: Okay, okay, okay, so pause right there. We are now 14 levels into this mess of a game, and I have no idea what it is that I'm doing, no idea where this is really going or if this project is ever going to be finished, but I feel like there is something here in this concept, and I really wanna figure out what that something is. So what we have is a meta devlog narrative and a voice-to-level generator, voice-to-game generator you could say, and then this silly doll traversing the space that has my face on it. But most importantly, we have you, the player, and I'm saying this because if you're hearing these words, it means that you must exist. I play, therefore I am, as the saying goes. And so now, I'm of course curious. What are you thinking out there? Where would you want this whole thing to go next? What's the gold and what is the trash here? And I have lured you now all the way to the end of my little demo, and so now I can suddenly shove this kind of call to action in your face to use business language, and that call to action is to give me your unfiltered thoughts about this world and this concept. But first, after all the real value of using this place happens when you interact with it. So why wouldn't you also have a say in what it looks like? Like we're already co-creating this experience, so why couldn't we co-create the world in which it takes place? So I'm going to invite you to tell me what you really think and what I should really be doing. So please enter the land of co-creation by stepping through this final demo portal.
